content.short: Genopets: Pixelton Arena is a Telegram mini app from Genopets for turn-based pet battles, rankings, and Energy rewards.
content.description: Genopets: Pixelton Arena brings the Genopets universe into Telegram with retro turn-based battles. Players summon a Genopet, battle friends, level up moves and stats, earn Energy from matches, and climb leaderboards for rewards. It is best understood as a Telegram game experience connected to Genopets, not as a separate wallet or exchange. Relive the turn-based battles that made your childhood unforgettable in our new Telegram mini app.Win → Rank → E.
